style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible strokes and layered hatching on textured paper, warm grey, mustard yellow and soft orange

pages.scene: One single short-haired cat sitting upright, seen from the side facing left, its long straight whiskers spreading out to both sides of its face, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
